description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Water], [Awoken Sharpshooter], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Ace Shot Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Sharpshooter
description.text: Sharpshooter abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Sharpshooter abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Ace Shot Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Ace Shot after using three Sharpshooter abilities
